summary: A Hindi-language Python tutorial (part 1) in which the presenter installs opencv-python, PyAutoGUI, pywin32 and numpy, then writes in VS Code the setup code for a screen recorder (screen size, VideoWriter, start time and duration).

questions.question: On the PyPI page for the Windows extensions package that the presenter opens near the start, what version number is shown next to 'pywin32'?
During the recap near the end, which import line does the presenter delete from the code, leaving only three import lines?
When the presenter searches for 'win32 api' and then says it is the wrong package, what package name and version are shown on the PyPI page he opened?
Why does the presenter add 'plus five' to the recording duration?
questions.answer: Because the recorder needs about 4-5 seconds to shut down; without it a 10-second recording comes out only about 6 seconds long
